methodologyNotes: Numeric specs use US units: max amperage (A), power in kilowatts (kW), input voltage 240V (Level 2 only), cable length in feet (ft), MSRP in USD. Connector type is J1772 or NACS. Install type distinguishes plug-in NEMA 14-50 from hardwired. wifi_smart and energy_star are booleans. Scope: Level 2 (240V) home wallboxes only; DC fast chargers and Level 1 trickle cords excluded. Research method: WebSearch to locate manufacturer and authoritative review pages, then WebFetch of manufacturer store/product pages and established review sites (EVChargingStations, Electrek, EnergySage, EV Adept) as primary sources. Prices are the regular/list MSRP - not sale or rebate-adjusted prices - except where only sale price was available from the manufacturer directly. Unpublished or unresolvable values are null.
